title: Rhythm Conductor · Classic
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Rhythm Conductor · Classic with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Choose a four-beat pattern of claps and pauses and one partner. The lead silently signals each beat with a hand; the partner performs the agreed pattern in time. The partner completes the pattern with the lead's four signals. Each player takes two turns. Give the lead one point for each successful turn. Highest score wins; ties are shared.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 2–8 players; materials: None.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Rhythm Conductor, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The partner completes the pattern with the lead's four signals.
The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
The group ends the round before anyone plays.
recall.why: The partner completes the pattern with the lead's four signals.
